adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the DB is updated first via prisma.booking.update(...attendees.createMany...) and only afterward calls await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking) with no try/catch and no compensating rollback. If the calendar update throws, the mutation errors out while the new attendees remain persisted. A subsequent retry will compute uniqueGuests by filtering out existing booking.attendees and can hit the `uniqueGuests.length === 0` BAD_REQUEST path, preventing calendar sync/emails from ever succeeding for those guests.
